body.name: projected bias-aware interval
body.construction: Let \(\Pi_M(x)=\min\{2M,\max\{-2M,x\}\}\). Set \(I^\star=[\Pi_M(\widehat\tau(v^\star))-\Psi_\alpha(v^\star),\Pi_M(\widehat\tau(v^\star))+\Psi_\alpha(v^\star)]\cap[-2M,2M]\) when \(\Psi_\alpha(v^\star)<2M\), and set \(I^\star=[-2M,2M]\) otherwise. The projected center belongs to \([-2M,2M]\), so the displayed intersection is nonempty on every observed assignment path.
